mapper.select: SELECT h.id AS handoff_id, h.task_id, t.user_id, t.application_id, h.state AS handoff_state, t.state AS task_state, h.generation, h.attempts, h.claim_owner, h.lease_until, h.enqueued_at, h.next_attempt_at, h.last_error FROM generation_task_handoff h JOIN generation_task t ON t.id = h.task_id WHERE (h.state IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND (h.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR h.next_attempt_at <= NOW(3))) OR (h.state = 'CLAIMED' AND h.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND h.lease_until < NOW(3)) ORDER BY h.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_task_handoff SET state = 'CLAIMED', claim_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), generation = generation + 1, attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state IN ('PENDING','RETRY')

UPDATE generation_task_handoff SET state = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(3), completion_reason = #{reason}, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'CLAIMED' AND generation = #{generation}

UPDATE generation_task_handoff SET state = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(3), completion_reason = #{reason}, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state = #{state}
UPDATE generation_task_handoff SET next_attempt_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND state IN ('PENDING','RETRY')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_task_handoff WHERE state = #{state}

SELECT h.id AS handoff_id, h.task_id, t.user_id, t.application_id, h.state AS handoff_state, t.state AS task_state, h.generation, h.attempts, h.claim_owner, h.lease_until, h.enqueued_at, h.next_attempt_at, h.last_error FROM generation_task_handoff h JOIN generation_task t ON t.id = h.task_id WHERE h.task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT h.id AS handoff_id, h.task_id, t.user_id, t.application_id, h.state AS handoff_state, t.state AS task_state, h.generation, h.attempts, h.claim_owner, h.lease_until, h.enqueued_at, h.next_attempt_at, h.last_error FROM generation_task_handoff h JOIN generation_task t ON t.id = h.task_id ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
